recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-31880 unless the work group later revisits special text-search semantics more broadly.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 issue requesting a Composition search parameter named section-text that searches Composition.section.text and does not search Composition.text.
initial_application: Commit 586441a2c8, titled FHIR-31880 Allow searching text of a document, added Composition-section-text to source/composition/bundle-Composition-search-params.xml. The current source retains the parameter with code section-text, type special, and expression Composition.repeat(section).text.
additional_context: FHIR-31743 is the companion section-code-text request and was implemented in the same historical commit. SDWG May 2021 minutes confirm approval of both requests. A Zulip implementers thread clarified that _text searches Resource.text, which explains why Composition.section.text needed separate search support. Later FHIR-49784 changed section-related expressions to Composition.repeat(section), preserving this issue while adding recursive section coverage.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scoped source already satisfies the request and excludes Composition.text.
